item.title: Hemp growers take one step back - Vote Hemp
item.description: A combine harvests hemp at South Bend Industrial Hemp's Field in Stafford County last year. Last year, Kansas farmers planted 4,000 acres of hemp but harvested only 700 acres, according to the Kansas Department of Agriculture, and now fewer farmers are concerned about aspects of the crop’s viability. “Things are headed in the wrong direction,” [...]

item.title: USDA Publishes National Hemp Report for 2021
item.description: The USDA National Agricultural Statistics Service (NASS) published the 2021 National Hemp Report compiled from survey data collected from hemp growers. The report estimates that in 2021, the value of hemp production in the open and under protection for the United States totaled $824 million. NASS reports that there were 54,152 acres of hemp planted […]

item.title: FDA Mulls Regulating CBD Products - Vote Hemp
item.description: The U.S. FDA is considering regulating CBD products. FDA will consider the safety of legal cannabis-infused food and supplements.

item.title: Bi-partisan group introduces "Free to Grow Act" in House - Vote Hemp
item.description: Today, a bipartisan coalition of House legislators introduced the “Free to Grow Act” to end the unfair drug felony prohibition for hemp farmers. item.title: World's Tallest Hemp Hotel Opens in South Africa - Vote Hemp
item.description: A new hotel made from hemp has opened in South Africa, marking a major milestone for the country’s green building sector.
